text: 针对全市场选股基金“宽基窄投”问题，《运作办法》要求非行业主题基金应当坚持分散投资原则，不得集中投资于单一行业或主题。若产品定位为全市场选股，就应按其定位进行相对分散配置，不能实质上演变为某一赛道基金。
text_en: In response to the problem of "broad-based selection with narrow investment" in all-market stock-selection funds, the Operation Measures require that non-sector-theme funds adhere to the principle of diversified investment and not concentrate investment in a single industry or theme. If a product is positioned as all-market stock selection, it should make relatively diversified allocations according to its positioning and cannot in substance evolve into a single-track fund.
